class.name: TextSystemFallback
class.brief_description: A fallback implementation of Orblit's text server, without support for BiDi and complex text layout.
class.description: A fallback implementation of Orblit's text server. This fallback is faster than [TextSystemAdvanced] for processing a lot of text, but it does not support BiDi and complex text layout. [b]Note:[/b] This text server is not part of official Orblit binaries. If you want to use it, compile the engine with the option [code]module_text_system_fallback_enabled=yes[/code]. When building with [TextSystemFallback], consider also disabling [TextSystemAdvanced] with [code]module_text_system_advanced_enabled=no[/code] to reduce binary size.
